_meta.purpose: Emotional sentences for Healthy 32 Dental and Implant Centre | Smiles & Skin in Hinglish. Adds warmth and human feel. Used selectively — not every review needs one. Dental anxiety → relief is the core emotion here.
rules: Dental-specific emotions: fear before, relief after, confidence about smile
Family angle works well — brought kids, came with spouse, referred relatives
Short punchy sentences work better than long emotional speeches
Must feel genuine — not dramatic or exaggerated
3-star gets almost none — neutral patients don't feel this strongly
Clinic offers dental + implants + skin care (Smiles & Skin). Do not name a specific doctor unless the profile has one.
